metadata.name: UpdateCardLoadLimit
metadata.description: Use this API to update load limits set on account along with card limit and card to card transfer limit.

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked Example: 1.3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of sender Example:  10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source from where API Call is initiated. CoreCard have multiple value of source for internal system (CoreMoney, SelfService, IVR, MobileSelfService) For external system expected source will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller Id of source from where API is initiated. It is End User phone number. Example: 7204454214 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called Id of destination for which API is initiated. It is Corecard IVR number. Example: 7314145404 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ANI
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: DNS
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Flag to retrieve error message in specific language Example: 'en' for English Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: RequestDate
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM-DD-YYYYTHH:MM:SS Example:- 11-12-2021T13:05:10 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: CardNumber
request_fields.description: Card Number of the cardholder Valid values: 0-9 Example: 123456******0001 Condition: At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number/Account Number is required. Allowable Values: 16

request_fields.name: ProxyNumber
request_fields.description: This tag indicates the Proxy Number of the cardholder Valid values:0-9 Condition: At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number/Account Number is required. Example:1617358 etc. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account Number of the cardholder. Valid values: 0-9 Condition: At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number/Account Number is required. Example: 2000000000000396893 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: SingleTransactionLoadLimit
request_fields.description: Maximum load amount allowed for a transaction Example : 500.00 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: DailyLoadLimitCount
request_fields.description: Sum of Loads allowed on a card in a day Example : 3 Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: DailyLoadLimitAmount
request_fields.description: Number of Loads allowed on a card in a day Example : 3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: WeeklyLoadLimitCount
request_fields.description: Sum of Loads allowed on a card in a week Example : 3 Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: WeeklyLoadLimitAmount
request_fields.description: Number of Loads allowed on a card in a week Example : 3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: MonthlyLoadLimitCount
request_fields.description: Sum of Loads allowed on a card in a month Example : 3 Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: MonthlyLoadLimitAmount
request_fields.description: Number of Loads allowed on a card in a month Example : 3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CardLimitAmount
request_fields.description: Card limit Example : 25000 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CardToCardSingleTransactionAmount
request_fields.description: Maximum amount allowed for a card to card transaction Example : 500.00 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CardToCardDailyLimitCount
request_fields.description: Sum of card to card transaction allowed on a card in a day Example : 3 Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: CardToCardDailyLimitAmount
request_fields.description: Number of card to card transaction allowed on a card in a day Example : 3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: NotesReason
request_fields.description: Description :  This tag indicates PreDefined Memo Reasons. Please refer appendix Section : Memo Reason Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: NotesText
request_fields.description: Notes entered by the user Valid Values : A-Z,0-9 Example : Card found Allowable Values: 500

response_fields.name: Message
response_fields.description: Returns Error Message in case of Error.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: Returns result of API processing. If any error is found then value will be 'false' else 'true'.

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Returns Error Code in case of Error.

response_fields.name: ResponseData
response_fields.description: This is group of below data elements.
